title: Solving rational expectations models on non-periodic time domains
title_zh: 非周期时间域上理性预期模型的求解
title_primary: 非周期时间域上理性预期模型的求解
title_secondary: Solving rational expectations models on non-periodic time domains
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Several economically relevant events, such as policy interventions or nominal adjustments, occur at irregular intervals. This paper extends the martingale difference reduction technique to multivariate rational expectations (RE) models on non-periodic time domains. We establish an invariance property showing that, under constant parameters, the recursive solution structure depends on the ordering of events rather than their calendar spacing. Standard likelihood-based estimation therefore applies without modification to irregularly timed observations. We also characterize equilibrium multiplicity by distinguishing components associated with arbitrary initial conditions and non-fundamental forecast errors. Monte Carlo evidence illustrates these results and shows that interpolation onto a regular grid can introduce substantial bias and distort inference.
abstract_zh: 若干与经济相关的重大事件，如政策干预或名义调整，往往在不规则的时间间隔内发生。本文将对鞅差缩减技术扩展到非周期时间域上的多元理性预期（RE）模型中。我们确立了一个不变性性质，表明在参数恒定的情况下，递归解的结构取决于事件的顺序而非其日历间隔。因此，基于似然的标准估计方法无需修改即可适用于不规则时间观测数据。我们还通过区分与任意初始条件及非基本面预测误差相关的组成部分，刻画了均衡多重性。蒙特卡洛证据验证了这些结果，并表明将数据插值到规则网格上可能引入显著偏差，扭曲推断结果。

title: Costs of Adjustment, Portfolio Separation, and the Dynamic Behavior of Bank Loans and Deposits – Revised
title_zh: 调整成本、资产组合分离与银行贷款和存款的动态行为——修订版
title_primary: 调整成本、资产组合分离与银行贷款和存款的动态行为——修订版
title_secondary: Costs of Adjustment, Portfolio Separation, and the Dynamic Behavior of Bank Loans and Deposits – Revised
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We revise the solutions of the dynamic optimization model of Elyasiani, Kopecky, and Van Hoose (1995), and show that the optimal policy function for the case of adjustment costs and no portfolio separation is a vector autoregressive model of order 1, and not of order 2. In addition, the empirical approach of Elyasiani, Kopecky, and Van Hoose (1995) is incorrect. The optimal policy functions for the no portfolio separation case have to be estimated with a panel vector autoregression model and not with a simultaneous equation approach. We also describe how the portfolio separation hypothesis can be tested empirically based on the correct policy functions.
abstract_zh: 我们修正了Elyasiani、Kopecky和Van Hoose（1995）动态优化模型的解，并表明在存在调整成本且无资产组合分离的情况下，最优政策函数是一阶向量自回归模型，而非二阶。此外，Elyasiani、Kopecky和Van Hoose（1995）的实证方法存在错误。对于无资产组合分离情形，最优政策函数应通过面板向量自回归模型进行估计，而非采用联立方程方法。我们还阐述了如何基于正确的政策函数对资产组合分离假说进行实证检验。

title: Tariff-Dispersion Shocks: The Mean is the Variance
title_zh: 关税离散冲击：均值即方差
title_primary: 关税离散冲击：均值即方差
title_secondary: Tariff-Dispersion Shocks: The Mean is the Variance
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the joint behavior over time of the mean and dispersion of U.S. import tariff rates across goods at the HTS 6-digit level, as well as the macroeconomic consequences of the shocks that drive these two moments. We document that the cross-sectional mean and the cross-sectional dispersion of import tariffs move closely together over time. Using a state-space model, we find that both are driven primarily by common shocks, while mean- and dispersion-specific tariff shocks play a negligible role. Thus, effectively, there are no separate mean-tariff shocks or tariff-dispersion shocks; there are only mean-dispersion tariff shocks. These common shocks account for a sizable share of movements in imports and the trade balance but only a small fraction of movements in output. A positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shock reduces the import-to-output ratio and improves the trade-balance-to-output ratio; a positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shock also reduces the import-to-output ratio but has a muted effect on the trade-balance-to-output ratio. Positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shocks are expansionary, whereas positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shocks are contractionary in the short run and expansionary in the medium run.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国进口关税税率在HTS六位数商品层面的均值与离散度随时间变化的联合行为，以及驱动这两个矩的冲击所产生的宏观经济后果。我们记录了进口关税的截面均值与截面离散度随时间紧密同步变动的现象。利用状态空间模型，我们发现两者主要由共同冲击驱动，而均值特定和离散度特定的关税冲击作用甚微。因此，实际上不存在独立的均值关税冲击或离散度关税冲击，仅存在均值-离散度关税冲击。这些共同冲击对进口和贸易余额的变动贡献显著，但对产出的变动影响甚小。正向的暂时性均值-离散度关税冲击降低了进口对产出之比，并改善了贸易余额对产出之比；正向的永久性均值-离散度关税冲击同样降低了进口对产出之比，但对贸易余额对产出之比的影响较为温和。正向的暂时性均值-离散度关税冲击具有扩张效应，而正向的永久性均值-离散度关税冲击在短期内具有收缩效应，在中期则呈现扩张效应。

title: Elections with Job-Motivated Bureaucrats
title_zh: 有工作动机官僚的选举
title_primary: 有工作动机官僚的选举
title_secondary: Elections with Job-Motivated Bureaucrats
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Bureaucratic voters are guided both by their preferences over public goods and by their job motivation: they bear costs from policies that downsize the government workforce. Job-motivated voters lead to (i) nonexistence of Condorcet-winning platforms in the short run, and (ii) bureaucratic persistence in the long run: equilibrium outcomes converge to alternations around at most two platforms, in which parties compete over the scale of public investment but keep the size of the bureaucracy fixed. Long-run bureaucracies are never smaller than the ideal bureaucracy of median private sector workers, and parties typically underinvest, so that public goods production is inefficient.
abstract_zh: 官僚选民既受其对公共物品偏好的引导，也受其职业动机的影响：他们承担着因缩减政府工作人员规模的政策而带来的成本。具有职业动机的选民导致（i）短期内不存在孔多塞胜出平台，以及（ii）长期内官僚体制的持续性：均衡结果收敛至至多两个平台之间的交替，在此过程中，政党围绕公共投资规模展开竞争，但保持官僚机构规模不变。长期官僚机构的规模绝不会小于私营部门中位工人理想中的官僚规模，且政党通常投资不足，从而导致公共物品生产效率低下。

title: Risk Management, Product Offerings, and Consumer Surplus: Evidence from the Insurance Industry
title_zh: 风险管理、产品供给与消费者剩余：来自保险业的证据
title_primary: 风险管理、产品供给与消费者剩余：来自保险业的证据
title_secondary: Risk Management, Product Offerings, and Consumer Surplus: Evidence from the Insurance Industry
authors: Cameron M. Ellis, Andrew Ellul, Chotibhak Jotikasthira, Jianren Xu
official: 官方在线 2025-12-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the causal impact of enterprise-wide risk management (ERM) — designed to move firms away from a "siloed" structure — on product decisions and consumer surplus. Exploiting the staggered rollout of an industry-wide ERM mandate in the insurance sector, we analyze life insurers’ offerings of annuities, which now account for nearly 70% of their premium revenues. We find that insurers respond by reducing risky guarantees, raising fees on the riskiest products, and shifting from traditional variable annuities toward index-linked products that provide natural hedges. To examine mechanisms and welfare outcomes, we develop a structural model that links consumer demand with multi-product supply. The ERM mandate imposes regulatory costs and corrects firms’ misperceptions about guarantee risk and cross-product risk interactions. Higher marginal costs for risky guarantees raise equilibrium prices and decrease their offerings, leading to substantial losses in consumer surplus. Overall, ERM reshapes insurers’ product strategies and risk exposures, enhancing financial stability but at a cost to consumers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业全面风险管理（ERM）——旨在推动企业摆脱“孤岛式”结构——对产品决策和消费者剩余的因果影响。利用保险行业一项全行业ERM强制要求的逐步实施，我们分析了寿险公司提供的年金产品，这些产品目前占其保费收入的近70%。我们发现，保险公司通过减少风险担保、对风险最高的产品提高费用，以及从传统可变年金转向提供自然对冲的指数挂钩产品来作出回应。为考察机制和福利结果，我们构建了一个将消费者需求与多产品供给联系起来的结构模型。该ERM强制要求施加了监管成本，并纠正了企业对担保风险及跨产品风险相互作用的错误认知。风险担保边际成本的上升提高了均衡价格并减少了其供给，导致消费者剩余大幅损失。总体而言，ERM重塑了保险公司的产品策略和风险敞口，增强了金融稳定性，但以消费者利益为代价。

title: Macroprudential regulation and banks’ supply of liquidity services
title_zh: 宏观审慎监管与银行流动性服务供给
title_primary: 宏观审慎监管与银行流动性服务供给
title_secondary: Macroprudential regulation and banks’ supply of liquidity services
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Are banks safer when they hold more safe assets? This paper builds a model in which banks supply liquidity services through uninsured deposits. Define a safe asset as an asset with both low payoff risk and high pledgeability. Banks consider equity costly and because of safe assets’ low payoff risk prefer to fund them largely with deposits. High pledgeability makes this feasible. The rise in banks’ deposit supply increases deposit rates and forces banks to deviate from socially desirable levels of capital to meet return-on-equity targets. Regulatory leverage ratios can be tightened to increase welfare.
abstract_zh: 银行持有更多安全资产时是否更安全？本文构建了一个模型，其中银行通过未保险存款提供流动性服务。将安全资产定义为既具有低支付风险又具有高可质押性的资产。银行视股权成本高昂，并因安全资产的低支付风险而倾向于大量以存款为其融资。高可质押性使这一做法成为可能。银行存款供给的增加推高了存款利率，迫使银行偏离社会合意的资本水平以满足股本回报率目标。监管杠杆比率可被收紧以提升社会福利。

title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
title_zh: 全球企业与资本市场模型
title_primary: 全球企业与资本市场模型
title_secondary: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
authors: Loukas Karabarbounis, Bruno Pellegrino, Juliana Salomao
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个全球经济的总体均衡模型，该模型将产品市场中竞争的异质性企业与在全球范围内配置资本的国家相结合。通过将产品侧的享乐需求系统与资产侧的均值-方差投资组合系统相结合，我们得到了模型均衡的近似闭式解。我们利用企业层面的资产负债表数据、收入和就业的地理分布数据以及业务描述，结合国家层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，将模型量化应用于48个国家约23,000家上市公司的横截面数据。我们运用该模型评估全球化带来的重新配置和福利效应。金融和贸易自由化均将活动集中于规模最大的企业并提升福利，其中新兴经济体和中型开放经济体分别获得更大的收益。产品市场和资本市场的摩擦相互放大，这意味着对其中一个市场的自由化会减少另一个市场自由化的收益。

title: Can Temperature Shock Lead to Higher Spending on Unhealthy Foods among U.S. Households
title_zh: 温度冲击会导致美国家庭增加不健康食品支出吗
title_primary: 温度冲击会导致美国家庭增加不健康食品支出吗
title_secondary: Can Temperature Shock Lead to Higher Spending on Unhealthy Foods among U.S. Households
authors: Adhikari, Prabin, Kassas, Bachir, Nayga, Rodolfo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Rising temperatures may influence everyday food choices in ways that have important implications for nutrition and public health. This paper studies how short-run exposure to extreme temperatures affects the composition of household grocery purchases in the United States. Using a nationally representative household panel dataset of grocery transactions merged with local weather information, we exploit within-household variation and estimate two-way fixed effects models to identify causal effects. We find that hotter weeks consistently shift food purchases toward less healthy items and reduce overall diet quality, with little change in total grocery spending. In contrast, unusually cold weeks lead to slight increases in total spending but do not significantly alter the nutritional composition of purchases. These results suggest that heat exposure primarily induces households to reallocate spending toward less healthy foods rather than to change how much they spend, whereas cold exposure mainly affects the volume of groceries purchased. The heat-induced effects on healthiness of food purchases are modest in the short run but are highly robust and more pronounced for households with less healthy baseline purchasing patterns. These findings highlight an underexplored channel through which rising temperatures may degrade diet quality, underscoring the potential public health and welfare costs of climate change.
abstract_zh: 气温上升可能会以对营养和公共健康具有重要影响的方式改变日常食品选择。本文研究了短期极端温度暴露如何影响美国家庭杂货购买的结构。利用一个全国代表性的家庭面板数据集，其中包含杂货交易记录并与当地天气信息相匹配，我们利用家庭内部变动，并估计双向固定效应模型以识别因果效应。研究发现，较热的周持续将食品购买转向较不健康的项目，并降低整体饮食质量，而总杂货支出变化不大。相反，异常寒冷的周导致总支出略有增加，但并未显著改变购买的营养构成。这些结果表明，热暴露主要促使家庭将支出重新分配至较不健康的食品，而非改变其支出总额，而冷暴露则主要影响所购杂货的数量。热诱导的食品购买健康性影响在短期内较为温和，但高度稳健，并且对于基线购买模式较不健康的家庭更为显著。这些发现突显了一个未被充分探索的渠道，通过该渠道，气温上升可能降低饮食质量，强调了气候变化潜在的公共健康与福利成本。

title: Credit Card Banking
title_zh: 信用卡银行业
title_primary: 信用卡银行业
title_secondary: Credit Card Banking
authors: Itamar Drechsler, Hyeyoon Jung, Weiyu Peng, Dominik Supera, Guanyu Zhou
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Credit card interest rates currently average 22%, an 18% spread over the short rate. This spread far exceeds that on any other loan or bond, yet nearly half of households are credit card borrowers. Why are credit card rates so high? To understand this, and the economics of credit card banking, we use regulatory account-level data to analyze the lifetime cash flows of 550 million monthly accounts, representing 90% of the US credit card market. While charge-off rates are comparatively high, averaging around 6%, they explain only a fraction of cards' spread. Reward payments and non-interest expenses are more than offset by interchange and non-interest income. Operating expenses, particularly marketing, are very large, and are used to generate pricing power. Yet, after deducting them, card lending still earns a 6.8% return on assets (ROA), more than four times the banking sector's ROA. Using the cross section of accounts, we estimate that credit card rates price in a 4.3% default risk premium, similar to high-yield bonds. Accounting for this, card lending earns an alpha of around 1.5% relative to the aggregate bank sector.
abstract_zh: 信用卡利率目前平均为22%，较短期利率高出18个百分点。这一利差远超任何其他贷款或债券，然而近半数的家庭却是信用卡借款人。为何信用卡利率如此之高？为理解这一点及信用卡银行业的经济学原理，我们利用监管层面的账户数据，分析了5.5亿个月度账户的终身现金流，这些账户代表了美国信用卡市场的90%。尽管坏账率相对较高，平均约为6%，但这仅解释了信用卡利差的一小部分。奖励支付和非利息支出被交换费和非利息收入所抵消而有余。运营费用，尤其是营销费用，数额庞大，用于创造定价权。然而，在扣除这些费用后，信用卡贷款仍能获得6.8%的资产回报率（ROA），是银行业整体ROA的四倍多。利用账户的横截面数据，我们估计信用卡利率中包含了4.3%的违约风险溢价，与高收益债券相似。考虑到这一点，信用卡贷款相对于整个银行部门产生了约1.5%的超额收益（alpha）。

title: Broad and focused learning
title_zh: 广泛学习与聚焦学习
title_primary: 广泛学习与聚焦学习
title_secondary: Broad and focused learning
official: 官方在线 2026-08-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze how a regulator can learn about the \textit{aggregate} health of banks by asking \textit{individual} banks to understand and communicate risks. Focused learning (banks report on the same risks) disciplines banks, yielding higher quality information. Broad learning (reporting on different risks) yields better coverage of information. The information gain from either approach is undermined by banks reducing their exposure to designated risks, resulting in correlated risk exposures and regulatory blind spots. Having each bank report on all risks appears to combine the benefits of focused and broad learning -- but instead increases strategic complementarities across banks and weakens discipline.
abstract_zh: 我们分析监管者如何通过要求个别银行理解和沟通风险，来了解银行的总体健康状况。聚焦式学习（银行报告相同的风险）对银行形成约束，产生更高质量的信息。广泛式学习（报告不同的风险）则能提供更全面的信息覆盖。然而，这两种方式带来的信息增益都会因银行减少对指定风险的敞口而受损，导致风险敞口相关化及监管盲区。让每家银行报告所有风险看似结合了聚焦式与广泛式学习的优势——但实际上却加剧了银行间的战略互补性，削弱了约束力。

title: Exogenous stock liquidity improvements and voluntary disclosure
title_zh: 外生股票流动性改善与自愿性信息披露
title_primary: 外生股票流动性改善与自愿性信息披露
title_secondary: Exogenous stock liquidity improvements and voluntary disclosure
authors: Thomas C. Hagenberg, Brian P. Miller, Anish Sharma, Teri Lombardi Yohn
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study whether exogenous improvements in stock liquidity, unrelated to the information environment, affect managers’ disclosure choices. We exploit the 1997 Nasdaq reforms, which exogenously improved stock liquidity by reducing the non-information asymmetry components of the bid-ask spread, and find that Nasdaq firms reduced voluntary disclosure relative to a control group of unaffected firms. This evidence is consistent with managers substituting between components of the bid-ask spread when forming disclosure choices. Specifically, as the non-information asymmetry components decline, managers respond by decreasing disclosure, which in turn raises the information asymmetry component. Despite the reduction in disclosure and corresponding increase in information asymmetry, total stock liquidity nevertheless improves, suggesting that maintaining prior disclosure levels would have yielded minimal marginal benefits.
abstract_zh: 我们研究股票流动性的外生改善（与信息环境无关）是否会影响管理者的披露选择。我们利用1997年纳斯达克改革，该改革通过降低买卖价差中的非信息不对称成分，外生地提升了股票流动性，并发现相对于未受影响的对照组公司，纳斯达克公司在自愿披露方面有所减少。这一证据与管理者在形成披露选择时在买卖价差各成分之间进行替代的假设相一致。具体而言，随着非信息不对称成分的下降，管理者通过减少披露来应对，这反过来又提高了信息不对称成分。尽管披露减少且信息不对称相应增加，但总体股票流动性仍然改善，这表明维持原有披露水平所带来的边际收益可能微乎其微。

title: local non-bossiness
title_zh: 局部非老板性
title_primary: 局部非老板性
title_secondary: local non-bossiness
authors: Eduardo Duque-Rosas, Juan S. Pereyra, Juan Pablo Torres-Martínez
official: 官方在线 2026-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The student-optimal stable mechanism (DA), the most popular mechanism in school choice, is the only one that is stable and strategy-proof. However, when DA is implemented, a student can change the schools of others without changing her own. We show that this drawback is limited: a student cannot change her schoolmates while remaining at the same school. We refer to this new property as local non-bossiness and use it to provide a new characterization of DA that does not rely on stability. Furthermore, we show that local non-bossiness plays a crucial role in providing incentives to be truthful when students have preferences over their colleagues. As long as students have school-lexicographic preferences over colleagues—meaning that they first consider the school to which they are assigned and then their schoolmates—DA induces the only stable and strategy-proof mechanism. There is limited room to expand this preference domain without compromising the existence of a stable and strategy-proof mechanism.
abstract_zh: 学生最优稳定机制（DA）是学校选择中最常用的机制，也是唯一既稳定又防策略的机制。然而，在实施DA时，学生可以在不改变自身分配的情况下改变他人的学校分配。我们证明这一缺陷是有限的：学生无法在留在同一所学校的同时改变其同学。我们将这一新性质称为局部非专断性，并利用它提供了DA的一个不依赖稳定性的新特征刻画。此外，我们表明，当学生对同事有偏好时，局部非专断性在提供真实报告激励方面起着关键作用。只要学生对同事具有学校字典序偏好——即他们首先考虑被分配的学校，然后考虑同学——DA就能诱导出唯一稳定且防策略的机制。在不牺牲稳定且防策略机制存在性的前提下，扩展这一偏好域的空间十分有限。

title: Common Ownership and Collusion
title_zh: 共同所有权与合谋
title_primary: 共同所有权与合谋
title_secondary: Common Ownership and Collusion
authors: Vincent Abraham, Florian Ederer, Catarina Marvao
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了首个经验证据，表明共同所有权能促进显性共谋。我们的独特研究背景——瑞典合法卡特尔全体样本——使我们能够观察卡特尔的形成、持续与解散，而避免了困扰已侦测卡特尔研究的样本选择偏差。结合手工收集的所有权数据与全部注册卡特尔记录，我们计算了企业对的利润权重（κ），该指标衡量一家企业在多大程度上内化竞争对手的利润。更高的利润权重与卡特尔参与可能性增大相关，能预测未来的卡特尔参与，并与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关联。企业在卡特尔解散后也会立即降低其利润权重。然而，这种关系集中在那些内化竞争对手利润的企业参与共谋而竞争对手未参与的企业对中。因此，共同所有权补充了企业自身在显性共谋中的参与，但替代了其利润被内化的竞争对手的卡特尔参与。

title: DP513 Stochastic Devaluation Risk and the Empirical Fit of Target Zone Models
title_zh: 随机贬值风险与目标区模型的经验拟合
title_primary: 随机贬值风险与目标区模型的经验拟合
title_secondary: DP513 Stochastic Devaluation Risk and the Empirical Fit of Target Zone Models
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes a tractable and realistic nonlinear model of exchange rate dynamics, and argues that its predictions are consistent with available empirical evidence on exchange rate and interest differential behavior in real-life target zones. In our model, the exchange rate fluctuates between given boundaries for random lengths of time and jumps discretely when devaluations occur. We allow for stochastic variability in the likelihood and size of devaluations, and we provide explicit solutions for the stochastic processes followed by the exchange rate and by the expected rate of depreciation. The model produces realistic patterns of covariation between exchange rates and interest rate differentials, and provides interesting interpretations of available empirical evidence. We also specify how to infer devaluation risk from target zone data.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个易于处理且贴近现实的汇率动态非线性模型，并论证其预测结果与真实目标汇率区中汇率与利差行为的现有实证证据一致。在该模型中，汇率在给定边界内随机时长波动，并在发生贬值时发生离散跳跃。我们允许贬值概率与幅度存在随机变化性，同时为汇率及预期贬值率所遵循的随机过程提供显式解。该模型生成了汇率与利差之间符合现实的协动模式，并对现有实证证据提供了有趣的解释。我们还阐明了如何从目标汇率区数据中推断贬值风险。

title: Congestion in Onboarding Workers and Sticky R&D
title_zh: 新员工入职拥堵与粘性研发
title_primary: 新员工入职拥堵与粘性研发
title_secondary: Congestion in Onboarding Workers and Sticky R&D
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Adjusting the rate of R&D spending is costly if the probability of converting new hires into productive R&D workers ("onboarding") is decreasing in the number of hires ("congestion"). We show that such congestion induces R&D-producing firms to hire slowly in response to good shocks, and hoard workers in response to bad shocks, providing a microfoundation for the convex adjustment costs widely used to capture the delayed, hump-shaped response of R&D spending to shocks. Using novel, high-frequency productivity data on individual software developers collected from GitHub, we document quantitative evidence suggesting that congestion is an economically-significant feature of R&D investment production.
abstract_zh: 调整研发支出速度的成本高昂，前提是新员工转化为高效研发人员（即“入职适应”）的概率随招聘人数增加而下降（即“拥挤效应”）。我们证明，这种拥挤效应会促使研发型企业面对正向冲击时缓慢招聘，面对负向冲击时囤积员工，从而为广泛用于刻画研发支出对冲击呈现滞后驼峰型响应的凸调整成本提供了微观基础。通过从GitHub收集的个体软件开发者高频生产率数据，我们提供了量化证据，表明拥挤效应是研发投资生产中具有经济显著性的特征。

title: What Does Federal Oversight Do to Policing and Public Safety? Evidence from Seattle
title_zh: 联邦监督对警务与公共安全有何影响？来自西雅图的证据
title_primary: 联邦监督对警务与公共安全有何影响？来自西雅图的证据
title_secondary: What Does Federal Oversight Do to Policing and Public Safety? Evidence from Seattle
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates how federal oversight not precipitated by a major scandal influences policing behavior and public safety. The high-profile events triggering such scandals can independently affect policing and crime, confounding estimates of oversight effects. I examine a 2011 federal investigation into the Seattle Police Department. In response to the heightened scrutiny from the investigation, officers immediately and significantly reduced stops, particularly suspicious-activity and traffic stops in minority neighborhoods. These reductions had no detectable effect on public safety. I conclude that federal oversight implemented in the absence of scandals may lower the social cost of policing.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了并非由重大丑闻引发的联邦监督如何影响警务行为与公共安全。触发此类丑闻的高关注度事件可能独立影响警务与犯罪，从而混淆监督效应的估计。我研究了2011年对西雅图警察局的联邦调查。为应对调查带来的高度关注，警员立即显著减少了拦截行为，尤其是在少数族裔社区的嫌疑活动拦截和交通拦截。这些减少对公共安全未产生可察觉的影响。我得出结论：在无丑闻背景下实施的联邦监督可能降低警务的社会成本。

title: Predictable patterns of protest: The impact of agricultural cycles on social unrest in Kenya
title_zh: 可预测的抗议模式：农业周期对肯尼亚社会动荡的影响
title_primary: 可预测的抗议模式：农业周期对肯尼亚社会动荡的影响
title_secondary: Predictable patterns of protest: The impact of agricultural cycles on social unrest in Kenya
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates how the agricultural cycle influences protest behavior in Kenya from 2000 to 2019. Using satellite data to identify the crop cycle and local harvest periods at the lowest available administrative level (wards) and geocoded protest records, we find that protest activity does not decline during the harvest period but increases with a temporal lag. A dynamic difference-in-differences specification shows that protest activity gradually rises in the two to three months following harvest, peaking around the onset of the subsequent agricultural cycle. These patterns are consistent with theories of opportunity costs and seasonal scarcity. While the opportunity costs of protest participation are highest during harvest periods, they decline thereafter and coincide with the lean season, when household food stocks become exhausted. These findings are robust across empirical specifications and contribute to a deeper understanding of the temporal dynamics of unrest in agrarian settings. They also highlight the importance of timing in the design of rural development and conflict prevention policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2000年至2019年间农业周期如何影响肯尼亚的抗议行为。利用卫星数据识别最低行政层级（选区）的作物周期与当地收获期，并结合地理编码的抗议记录，我们发现抗议活动在收获期间并未减少，反而在时间滞后效应下有所增加。动态双重差分模型显示，抗议活动在收获后两至三个月内逐渐上升，并在后续农业周期开始时达到峰值。这些模式与机会成本及季节性稀缺理论相吻合：尽管收获期参与抗议的机会成本最高，但此后机会成本下降，恰逢家庭粮食储备耗尽的淡季。上述发现在不同实证设定中均保持稳健，有助于深化对农业社会动荡时间动态的理解，同时凸显了农村发展与冲突预防政策设计中时机选择的重要性。

title: Financial and real effects of fiscal risk
title_zh: 财政风险的金融与实际效应
title_primary: 财政风险的金融与实际效应
title_secondary: Financial and real effects of fiscal risk
authors: Denis Gorea, Ding Xuan Ng, Fabrizio Zampolli
official: 官方在线 2026-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Focus We examine what happens when investors question fiscal sustainability and demand higher sovereign bond yields as compensation for higher risk. We call these episodes fiscal risk shocks. Such shocks can arise, for example, from a government announcing new spending or tax cuts, or from news that worsens its budget outlook. We develop a new method to identify these shocks from daily movements in bond yields. When fiscal concerns intensify, investors retreat from government bonds and shift towards the safest corporate bonds, resulting in negative co-movement in the yields of these bonds. Exploiting this relationship, we extract fiscal risk shocks for 12 economies. We then trace how these shocks propagate through exchange rates, equity markets, inflation and output.
abstract_zh: 焦点 本文研究当投资者质疑财政可持续性并要求更高的主权债券收益率以补偿更高风险时会发生什么。我们将此类事件称为财政风险冲击。例如，此类冲击可能源于政府宣布新增支出或减税，或源于恶化其预算前景的消息。我们开发了一种新方法，通过债券收益率的日常变动来识别这些冲击。当财政担忧加剧时，投资者会从政府债券中撤出，转向最安全的公司债券，导致这些债券收益率出现负向联动。利用这一关系，我们提取了12个经济体的财政风险冲击。随后，我们追踪这些冲击如何通过汇率、股票市场、通胀和产出进行传导。

title: Nested removal of strictly dominated strategies in infinite games
title_zh: 无限博弈中严格占优策略的嵌套剔除
title_primary: 无限博弈中严格占优策略的嵌套剔除
title_secondary: Nested removal of strictly dominated strategies in infinite games
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We compare two procedures for the iterated removal of strictly dominated strategies. In the nested procedure, a strategy of a player is removed only if it is dominated by an unremoved strategy. The universal procedure is more comprehensive for it allows the removal of strategies that are dominated by previously removed ones. Outside the class of finite games, the two procedures may lead to different outcomes in that the universal one is always order independent while the other is not. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the equivalence of the two procedures. The conditions we give are based on completely bounded subsets of strategy profiles, which are variations of the bounded mechanisms from the literature on full implementation. The two elimination procedures are also shown to be equivalent in quasisupermodular games as well as in games with compact strategy spaces and upper semicontinuous payoff functions. Finally, we give an example of a game in which the nested procedure is order independent but not equivalent to the universal one, thus showing that order independence is not sufficient to guarantee the equivalence of the two elimination procedures.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了两种严格占优策略迭代剔除的程序。在嵌套程序中，只有当某个玩家的策略被一个未被剔除的策略所支配时，该策略才会被移除。通用程序则更为全面，因为它允许移除那些被先前已剔除策略所支配的策略。在有限博弈类之外，这两种程序可能导致不同的结果，即通用程序总是顺序无关的，而嵌套程序则不然。我们提供了这两种程序等价性的必要且充分条件。所给出的条件基于策略组合的完全有界子集，这些是完整实施文献中受限机制的变体。此外，我们还证明了这两种剔除程序在拟超模博弈以及具有紧策略空间和上半连续支付函数的博弈中是等价的。最后，我们给出了一个博弈示例，其中嵌套程序是顺序无关的，但与通用程序不等价，从而表明顺序无关性并不足以保证这两种剔除程序的等价性。

title: Financial conditions and green R&D
title_zh: 金融状况与绿色研发
title_primary: 金融状况与绿色研发
title_secondary: Financial conditions and green R&D
authors: Luca Fornaro, Veronica Guerrieri, Will Hotten, Lucrezia Reichlin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.
abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估计企业对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面影响。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展产生了系统性偏见。

title: Dynamically optimized sequential WTP elicitation: Application to the age and VSL relationship
title_zh: 动态优化的序贯支付意愿诱导：年龄与统计生命价值关系的应用
title_primary: 动态优化的序贯支付意愿诱导：年龄与统计生命价值关系的应用
title_secondary: Dynamically optimized sequential WTP elicitation: Application to the age and VSL relationship
authors: Yohei Mitani, Ao Liu, Henrik Lindhjem
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Large-scale experiments and surveys have become powerful tools for economists, measuring individual economic preferences that help explain economic behavior. However, willingness-to-pay (WTP) for public goods, derived from best-practice stated preference methods, typically relies on response variations to estimate population average preferences. We develop a new WTP elicitation method based on information theory and Bayesian updating that dynamically optimizes bids for a series of binary choices and independently elicits each participant’s WTP while collecting responses. We conduct an online survey experiment with over 1400 adults aged 20 to 79 in Japan to explore the relationship between age and the value of a statistical life (VSL) in a pandemic context at the individual level. First, Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that our adaptive method can provide accurate individual-level estimates of WTP with fewer questions than traditional non-adaptive methods. These estimates are highly correlated with “true” values, even at the extremes of WTP. Second, the VSL estimate among adults does not decrease with age, as sometimes seen in the literature; instead, it hits its lowest point in their 30s and 40s, then increases with age, even after controlling for a comprehensive set of covariates. Third, economic preferences are strongly associated with VSL. Participants who are loss tolerant, present biased, and prosocial tend to have a higher VSL on the intensive margin. Risk-averse, impatient, and selfish participants are more likely to have zero WTP on the extensive margin.
abstract_zh: 大规模实验和调查已成为经济学家的有力工具，用以衡量个体经济偏好，从而有助于解释经济行为。然而，基于最佳实践陈述偏好方法得出的公共物品支付意愿（WTP），通常依赖于响应变化来估计总体平均偏好。我们开发了一种基于信息论和贝叶斯更新的新型WTP诱导方法，该方法能动态优化一系列二元选择的出价，并在收集响应的同时独立诱导每位参与者的WTP。我们在日本对超过1400名20至79岁的成年人进行了在线调查实验，以个体层面探讨年龄与统计生命价值（VSL）在疫情背景下的关系。首先，蒙特卡洛模拟表明，我们的自适应方法能以比传统非自适应方法更少的问题提供准确的个体层面WTP估计。这些估计与“真实”值高度相关，即使在WTP的极端值处也是如此。其次，成年人的VSL估计并不随年龄增长而下降，这与文献中有时所见不同；相反，它在30多岁和40多岁时达到最低点，随后随年龄增长而上升，即使在控制了一组全面的协变量后也是如此。第三，经济偏好与VSL密切相关。损失容忍、现时偏向和亲社会的参与者在集约边际上倾向于有更高的VSL。风险厌恶、缺乏耐心和自私的参与者更可能在广延边际上有零WTP。

title: The Role of Special Economic Zones in Shaping Viet Nam’s Local Business Environment
title_zh: 经济特区在塑造越南本地商业环境中的作用
title_primary: 经济特区在塑造越南本地商业环境中的作用
title_secondary: The Role of Special Economic Zones in Shaping Viet Nam’s Local Business Environment
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines the effects of special economic zones (SEZs) on firm growth and the regional business environment in Viet Nam, highlighting their key role as a policy tool to attract foreign investors. Using detailed panel data from Viet Nam’s 63 provinces from 2006 to 2020 and instrumental variables (IV) estimations, this study provides new insights into how SEZs impact firm growth and several dimensions of economic governance. SEZs are found to play a dual role. Provinces with broader SEZ coverage experienced increases in employment, revenues, and the number of foreign-invested enterprises. In contrast, domestic private firms faced declines in both revenues and numbers. SEZ exposure had negative effects on several aspects of provincial economic governance including land access, transparency in policy-making, and informal charges. In addition, the approval of the first SEZ was also associated with increased prevalence of informal charges and preferential treatment of foreign-invested enterprises and other big companies, which may indicate heightened inefficiencies and rent-seeking concerns.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了越南经济特区（SEZs）对企业增长及区域营商环境的影响，凸显其作为吸引外资政策工具的关键作用。基于2006至2020年越南63个省份的详细面板数据，并采用工具变量（IV）估计方法，本研究揭示了经济特区如何影响企业增长及经济治理的多个维度。研究发现，经济特区发挥着双重作用。经济特区覆盖范围更广的省份，其就业、收入及外商投资企业数量均有所增长。相比之下，国内私营企业的收入与数量均出现下降。经济特区的设立对省级经济治理的若干方面产生了负面影响，包括土地获取、政策制定透明度及非正规收费。此外，首个经济特区的获批还与外商投资企业及其他大型企业非正规收费增加及优惠待遇加剧相关，这可能表明效率低下与寻租问题日益突出。

title: Development approval times and new housing supply: Evidence from Los Angeles
title_zh: 开发审批时间与新房供给：来自洛杉矶的证据
title_primary: 开发审批时间与新房供给：来自洛杉矶的证据
title_secondary: Development approval times and new housing supply: Evidence from Los Angeles
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the effect of local regulatory approval times on housing production. The analysis derives from a novel dataset of development timelines for all multifamily housing projects permitted by the City of Los Angeles between 2010 and 2022. Results indicate that a 25 percent reduction in approval times would have increased the rate of housing production in Los Angeles between 2010 and 2022 by 12.7 percent, simply by pulling forward in time the completion of projects already begun. The production gains are even larger upon accounting for the role of approval times in incentivizing new development. Discretionary approvals are shown to be especially salient to development timelines. The estimated impacts on development are also shown to be heterogeneous across project type and space, and correlated with neighborhood socioeconomic status. Results underscore the importance of municipal regulatory reform to the achievement of housing production goals.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了地方审批时间对住房建设的影响。分析基于一项新颖的数据集，涵盖了2010年至2022年间洛杉矶市批准的所有多户住宅项目的发展时间线。结果表明，审批时间缩短25%，仅通过提前完成已启动项目的时间，就能使洛杉矶在2010年至2022年间的住房建设率提高12.7%。在考虑审批时间对激励新开发项目的作用后，生产收益更为显著。自由裁量审批对发展时间线的影响尤为突出。估计对开发的影响在项目类型和空间上表现出异质性，并与社区社会经济状况相关。研究结果强调了市政监管改革对于实现住房建设目标的重要性。

title: A Generalized Endogenous Grid Method for Default Risk Models
title_zh: 违约风险模型的广义内生网格方法
title_primary: 违约风险模型的广义内生网格方法
title_secondary: A Generalized Endogenous Grid Method for Default Risk Models
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We extend the endogenous grid method to default risk models, which is faster and more accurate than grid search. Our method is 4 to 27 times faster and provides a more accurate bond price function, resulting in substantial differences in the predictions of the canonical sovereign debt model. When applied to Arellano's (2008) model, our approach predicts a standard deviation of the interest rate spread one‐third lower and defaults 3 to 5 times less frequently than does the conventional approach. Finally, we demonstrate that our method is applicable to a broad class of default risk models by characterizing sufficient conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们将内生网格方法扩展至违约风险模型，该方法比网格搜索更快且更精确。我们的方法速度快4至27倍，并提供更精确的债券价格函数，从而在经典主权债务模型的预测中产生显著差异。当应用于Arellano（2008）模型时，我们的方法预测的利率利差标准差比传统方法低三分之一，违约频率则低3至5倍。最后，我们通过刻画充分条件，证明该方法适用于广泛类别的违约风险模型。

title: Food insecurity and unemployment among immigrants in the United States
title_zh: 美国移民中的食品不安全与失业问题
title_primary: 美国移民中的食品不安全与失业问题
title_secondary: Food insecurity and unemployment among immigrants in the United States
authors: Siwen Zhou, Joshua Berning, Alessandro Bonanno, Jude Bayham
official: 官方在线 2026-04-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Immigrants can be more vulnerable to economic downturns and, during periods of economic hardship, more likely to experience food insecurity compared to natives. This study examines the differential effect of the unemployment rate on the probability of being food insecure among diverse groups of immigrant households relative to natives in the United States. Since the unemployment rate is not randomly determined for households, we use an identification strategy based on shift‐share Bartik instruments which exploit exogenous spatial variation in industry employment shares and national industry growth rates. We find that increases in the unemployment rate raise the probability of household food insecurity, with noncitizen immigrants disproportionately affected compared to both natives and naturalized citizens, likely reflecting their more limited access to safety‐net programs. Noncitizen immigrant cohorts from countries with high proportions of less‐skilled workers, or those arriving during economic downturns, are more likely to experience food insecurity than both native‐born individuals and naturalized immigrant citizens. Higher education partially mitigates the impact of unemployment on household food insecurity, particularly for U.S. immigrant noncitizens. Our findings highlight the need for targeted measures to support at‐risk immigrant groups disproportionately vulnerable to short‐term economic shocks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 移民在经济衰退时期可能比本土居民更加脆弱，并且在经济困难时期更易遭受食物不安全问题。本研究探讨了美国不同移民家庭群体相对于本土居民，失业率对食物不安全概率的差异化影响。鉴于失业率并非随机分配给家庭，我们采用基于转移份额巴蒂克工具变量的识别策略，利用行业就业份额和全国行业增长率的空间外生变化。研究发现，失业率上升会增加家庭食物不安全的概率，其中非公民移民受到的影响尤为显著，相较于本土居民和入籍公民，这很可能反映了他们获取安全网项目的机会更为有限。来自低技能工人比例较高国家或经济衰退期间抵达的非公民移民群体，比本土出生个体和入籍移民公民更易遭遇食物不安全。高等教育在一定程度上缓解了失业对家庭食物不安全的影响，尤其对美国非公民移民而言。我们的研究结果强调了采取针对性措施支持那些易受短期经济冲击影响的移民群体的必要性。

title: Does data element marketization policy reduce firm default risk? a quasi-natural experiment based on data trading platforms
title_zh: 数据要素市场化政策能否降低企业违约风险？——基于数据交易平台的准自然实验
title_primary: 数据要素市场化政策能否降低企业违约风险？——基于数据交易平台的准自然实验
title_secondary: Does data element marketization policy reduce firm default risk? a quasi-natural experiment based on data trading platforms
authors: Xuanjuan Chen Qisheng Tang Yetong Zhou a School of Finance, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Shanghai, Chinab Dishui Lake Advanced Finance Institute, China
official: 官方在线 2025-06-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Business operators, investment decision-makers and risk managers have increasingly emphasized data factors as drivers of development. This study uses data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2012 to 2022 to examine how data element marketization (DEM) reduces corporate default risk. The results show that DEM and default distance have a significantly positive relationship, indicating that DEM lowers default risk. The study finds that external monitoring, information asymmetry and investment efficiency are the main mechanisms through which DEM affects default risk. Moreover, executives’ digital backgrounds can significantly strengthen DEM’s impact on default risk. Finally, DEM can significantly reduce the default risk of high-tech companies or those in the decline stage of the business life cycle. This research not only helps policymakers understand how DEM can mitigate firm default risk but can also be generalized globally. KEYWORDS: Data elements marketization default risk information asymmetry investment efficiency executive digital background JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 D22 O16 Acknowledgements We thank the editor (Dierk Herzer) and the two anonymous reviewers. All remaining errors are our own.
abstract_zh: 经营者、投资决策者与风险管理者日益重视数据要素作为发展驱动力。本研究基于2012至2022年中国A股上市公司数据，考察数据要素市场化如何降低企业违约风险。结果表明，数据要素市场化与违约距离呈显著正相关关系，说明数据要素市场化降低了违约风险。研究发现，外部监督、信息不对称与投资效率是数据要素市场化影响违约风险的主要机制。此外，高管数字背景能够显著强化数据要素市场化对违约风险的影响。最后，数据要素市场化能显著降低高科技企业或处于生命周期衰退阶段企业的违约风险。本研究不仅有助于政策制定者理解数据要素市场化如何缓解企业违约风险，其结论亦可推广至全球范围。关键词：数据要素市场化；违约风险；信息不对称；投资效率；高管数字背景 JEL分类：G32 D22 O16 致谢：感谢编辑Dierk Herzer及两位匿名审稿人。文中所有疏漏由作者自行承担。
